policies.B1: An item attains premier operational status whenever its quarterly proportion of operational failures remains below 0.05% and it possesses a valid ISO 9001 credential.
policies.D1: An equipment model is eligible for placement with Clinical Supply Network provided the item earns premier operational status.
policies.B2: A medical item gains EcoHealth certification provided its organic latex content reaches at least 90%.
policies.B3: Headwear earns safety clearance if its impact resistance measures 400 joules or higher.
policies.B4: An appliance complies with energy guidelines when it possesses an active Energy Star certification.

decoy_policies: An industrial lubricant receives Premium Fleet Approval when its viscosity index exceeds 110 and its flash point reaches at least 200 degrees Celsius.
